items.text: InfoBillard is the most complete billiards management software for pool halls, golf simulators, snooker, darts, poker, kyo, soccer, air hockey, video gaming consoles, arcade, party centers and more. Manage billing and all activities for members and non-members related to game rentals.

modules.heading: SETTINGS /
modules.introText: Running on Windows with mouse or touchscreen, InfoBillard manages billing and all member and non-member activities related to game rentals. INFOBILLARD is fully configurable. InfoBillard modules will save you time and money while improving your customer service.

items.title: GAME MANAGEMENT
items.text: Control 1 to 256 games; manage reservations and notes; billing based on your rate criteria; individual or group billing; unlimited game types; security and password management; rental management; deposit management; waiting list management; premium management and more...

items.title: PROMOTIONS *
items.text: Modify regular game or product rates; create promotions for free time or bonus points; manage effective promotion periods; automatically activate promotions based on date and time and more...

items.title: MEMBERS *
items.text: Member profiles with photos; webcam photo capture; barcode member identification; unwanted member management; member types with or without discounts; subscription management; hour bank; member history; mail merge promotions and email promotions and more...

items.title: PRODUCTS *
items.text: Unlimited categories and products; inventory management; minimum quantity management; percentage or dollar discounts; member billing; table billing; product redistribution during billing and more...

items.title: RESERVATIONS *
items.text: Calendar-based reservation management by day, week, or month; reservation types with color coding; reservations for members or non-members; reservation notes and more...

items.title: COMMUNICATIONS *
items.text: Mail merge using Word documents or HTML pages for email; merge member database with filters; manage sent lists and documents; verify incomplete contact information; print address labels and more...

items.title: VIDEO LOTTERIES *
items.text: Create machines and their stickers; enter amounts paid per payment and per machine; batch transactions for groups of machines; print reports and payments on X or Z cash register reports and more...

items.title: MEV * (Quebec)
items.text: The Sales Recording Module (MEV) is the device used by Revenu Québec's technology solution for the restaurant industry. InfoBillard's MEV module enables communication between our software and the Revenu Québec device.
